rule: Only the user's explicit accept or decline decision changes a review group status.

lesson3-particle-structure-and-identity.acceptedJob: Use Lesson 3 as the canonical particle source model while keeping conjectural origins and missing evidence non-authorizing.

lesson3-particle-use-and-structural-limi.acceptedJob: Make particle rank and function affect normal application behavior, not merely a label or explanation.

lesson3-clause-introducing-particles.acceptedJob: Treat clause introducers as genuine grammatical choices whose placement and compatibility are application duties.

lesson3-adjunctor-in.acceptedJob: Unify optional adjunction with the existing clause relation system and keep translation non-authorizing.

lesson3-conjunctor-auh.acceptedJob: Keep one Nahuatl conjunction choice while allowing context-sensitive interpretation.

lesson3-adverbial-particles.acceptedJob: Make lexical choice user-facing only where meaning is genuinely intended; keep realization automatic.

lesson3-interjections-and-vocative.acceptedJob: Separate genuine expressive choice from automatic vocative realization.

lesson3-negative-particle-prefixes.acceptedJob: Make negative-prefix selection an application duty governed by the sentence environment.

lesson3-particle-collocations.acceptedJob: Treat Lesson 3 itself as the particle sequence pipeline rather than concatenating interface labels.
